description: This file implements tensor operations and engine/stream management for oneDNN integration in PyTorch, including tensor conversion, engine/stream retrieval, and data type handling.

classes.name: LlgaTensorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a tensor for oneDNN (MKL-DNN) integration, including conversion to ATen tensors.

classes.name: LlgaTensorDesc
classes.description: Descriptor for LLGA tensors, handling tensor properties and data type conversions.

methods.name: Engine::getEngine
methods.description: Returns a static instance of the CPU engine with a custom allocator.

methods.name: Stream::getStream
methods.description: Returns a static stream associated with the engine.

methods.name: LlgaTensorImpl::LlgaTensorImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing LLGA tensor implementation with storage, data type, and descriptor.

methods.name: LlgaTensorImpl::llga_to_aten_tensor
methods.description: Converts an LLGA tensor implementation to an ATen tensor.

methods.name: empty_llga
methods.description: Creates an empty LLGA tensor with specified descriptor and options.

methods.name: get_llga_desc
methods.description: Retrieves the LLGA descriptor from an MKL-DNN tensor.

methods.name: llga_from_aten_tensor
methods.description: Creates an LLGA tensor from an ATen tensor.

methods.name: LlgaTensorDesc::getLlgaDataType
methods.description: Maps ATen scalar types to oneDNN data types.

methods.name: LlgaTensorDesc::supplementTensorInfo
methods.description: Augments tensor descriptor with layout info based on input tensor.

methods.name: LlgaTensorDesc::aten_scalar_type
methods.description: Converts LLGA data type back to ATen scalar type.
